investigations.name: chromosome-cycle-calibration
investigations.title: v2ecoli chromosome cycle-time calibration on slow-growth conditions (acetate + glycerol)
investigations.description: Carefree investigation tracking v2ecoli chromosome dynamics on slow-growth media. Validates the architectural port (PartitionedProcess -> layered process-bigraph) against vEcoli on acetate, surfaces the upstream FBA-over-supply calibration gap (observed ~80 min cycle vs declared 136 min on acetate), and scaffolds the new glycerol medium (MIX0-845, tau=150 min, CRP-cAMP active). Lives on feat/aim2-dnaa-oric @ b8d0d1e.
investigations.question: Does v2ecoli reproduce vEcoli chromosome cycle dynamics on slow conditions, and at what point in the simulator stack does the observed-vs-declared cycle-time gap originate?
investigations.hypothesis: Confirmed today: v2ecoli reproduces vEcoli's acetate dynamics within ~15 uM ppGpp and ~3% charged-fraction across gen 1. The gap (observed ~80 min vs declared 136 min) is wcEcoli-inherited (FBA over-supplies AAs in early gen -> tRNA stays 97-98% charged -> SpoT degrades ppGpp -> ribosomes elongate fast). Rejected: multi-gen does NOT equilibrate to tau=136 (5-gen lineage cycles 42-82 min, no monotonic trend).

investigations.name: colonies
investigations.title: Colony Composite — HPC Scaling Readiness
investigations.description:
Two-study investigation to certify the colony composite for HPC
deployment.

Study 1 — colonies-01-hpc-readiness (this study):
  Build phase: fix daughter-process hydration so structural _add
  instantiates daughter EcoliWCMs through the composite engine.
  Decide phase: N-sweep (N ∈ {1, 2, 4, 8}) on one machine to
  extract per-cell wall-time + RSS scaling and identify the
  bottleneck. Produces a recommended cells/process and
  cells/HPC-node budget.

Study 2 — colonies-02-hpc-deployment (planned):
  Cross-node validation of the projected sizing. Run the
  recommended cells-per-process count across many processes on
  one HPC node, then across multiple nodes; confirm per-cell wall
  stays within ±20% of the laptop projection and that biology is
  consistent between distributed configurations.
investigations.question:
How many whole-cell E. coli agents can we fit per HPC node, and at
what per-cell wall-time cost, so that a colonies-on-HPC workload is
realistic to plan against? More fundamentally: does the multi-cell
colony composite (each cell embedding the full 55-process WCM via
EcoliWCM) actually support clean parallel growth + division at
scale, or are there per-cell-cost or per-cell-RAM cliffs that show
up only at N > 1?
investigations.hypothesis:
After fixing daughter-process hydration, the colony composite scales
linearly with N (per-cell wall ≈ constant, per-cell RAM ≈ constant)
on a single machine for N up to at least 8, and the dominant cost
is the inner EcoliWCM (not pymunk or scheduler). HPC sizing is then
a function of (RAM_per_node / RAM_per_cell, cores_per_node /
cells_per_process_at_realtime). The single bottleneck visible at
laptop scale will be the Python GIL — process-bigraph composites
are single-threaded by design, so HPC scaling means scaling
processes, not cells per process.

investigations.name: dnaa-replication
investigations.title: DnaA / Replication Initiation (succinate, fresh start 2026-05-29)
investigations.question:
Can v2ecoli reproduce DnaA-driven replication initiation in succinate at
STEADY STATE — periodic oriC + cell-mass + DnaA dynamics across multiple
generations — using ParCa's native succinate parameters with no imposed
τ / C / D overrides?
investigations.hypothesis:
In succinate (τ ≈ 70–80 min, ParCa-default C = 40 min, D = 20 min,
B = τ − C − D > 0), v2ecoli with a tuned dnaA RNA-synthesis probability
(Mechanism A: sim_data.genetic_perturbations["TU00259[c]"] = 2e-3
runtime overwrite) holds the DnaA monomer pool in the literature
[300, 800] band across generations and produces a non-overlapping cell
cycle that initiates replication exactly once per cycle. The cycle
proceeds: cell starts with 1 oriC, replication initiates once near the
end of B-period, oriC briefly doubles to 2, replication completes after
C-period, D-period elapses, division fires, daughters start the same
cycle again — never reaching 4 oriC simultaneously.

investigations.name: v2ecoli-baseline-showcase
investigations.title: v2ecoli Baseline Showcase: from ecoli-sources to a calibrated whole cell
investigations.question:
Can v2ecoli, starting from the raw ecoli-sources flat files, rebuild the
ParCa in full, run a wild-type baseline single-cell→division ensemble that
reproduces measured E. coli properties (doubling time, mass fractions, FBA
fluxes, proteome), and then characterize a perturbation response? This is a
DEMONSTRATIVE walkthrough of the v2ecoli pipeline rather than a test of a
scientific hypothesis — the goal is to exhibit the full path
(ecoli-sources → ParCa → calibrated whole cell → perturbation) working
end-to-end and to hand reviewers an explicit perturbation-choice decision.

investigations.name: v2ecoli-pdmp
investigations.title: v2ecoli → PDMP Whole-Cell Model Reformulation
investigations.question:
Can v2ecoli's hybrid algorithmic whole-cell model be incrementally
transformed into a piecewise-deterministic Markov process (PDMP)
suitable for likelihood-based inference and causal discovery, without
discarding the biological knowledge encoded in the current WCM, and
while maintaining viable E. coli growth at every phase boundary?
investigations.hypothesis:
A six-phase incremental replacement — (0) Markov-blanket
characterization, (1) v2ecoli's multi-objective FBA → kinetic ODE
metabolism, (2) discrete-time → continuous-time jump processes,
(3) observation-likelihood and
Bayesian-interface infrastructure, (4) compiled column-centric runtime,
(5) Bayesian gene-function annotation — yields a PDMP-class WCM that
(a) reproduces Phase-0 interface statistics within tolerance at every
later phase, (b) admits well-formed process likelihoods at Phase 3,
(c) achieves ≥10³ parallel single-cell trajectories with near-zero
marshalling overhead at Phase 4, and (d) recovers known E. coli gene
functions with credible intervals on a benchmark set at Phase 5.
